title: Package assets copied into App_Plugins
description: A package that copies its backoffice files into App_Plugins on build, so a folder that matches a package reference holds a package.manifest.

impact.summary: package.manifest is no longer supported; the package needs its release for the target.

sources.evidence: The package.manifest file is no longer supported and has been replaced with the umbraco-package.json file

handling.option: Upgrade the package to its release for the target, then remove the old copied folder with an approval
handling.when: A release exists for the target

sources.evidence: The package.manifest file is no longer supported and has been replaced with the umbraco-package.json file
This article will cover the process of installing as well as uninstalling packages from your Umbraco CMS website

checks.text: The package UI works on the local site and the old copied folder is gone from source control
